title: Tackling lower value tax debts
text:
This consultation proposes extending existing powers to recover lower value tax debts through direct monthly deductions from customers who persistently do not engage with HMRC, with safeguards for individuals including those who require extra support.

 It seeks views on the policy’s scope, operation and proposed safeguards, as well as its impacts and how to ensure it is fair and effective.
